entries.description: Only brahmins are the best class
entries.subject: Only

spans.text: They exchanged greetings, and when the greetings and polite conversation were over, the king sat down to one side and said to Mahākaccāna: “brāhmaṇā, bho kaccāna, evamāhaṁsu: “Worthy Kaccāna, the brahmins say: ‘brāhmaṇova seṭṭho vaṇṇo, hīno añño vaṇṇo; ‘Only brahmins are the best class; other classes are inferior.
brāhmaṇova sukko vaṇṇo, kaṇho añño vaṇṇo; Only brahmins are the light class; other classes are dark.
brāhmaṇāva sujjhanti, no abrāhmaṇā; Only brahmins are purified, not others.
Only brahmins are the the Divinity’s bosom sons, born from his mouth, born of the Divinity, created by the Divinity, heirs of the Divinity.’
